tuning_checklist: Lead with your direct recommendation in sentence 1 before listing caveats.

State material uncertainty once and omit conversational throat-clearing.

faq.q: Does this profile mean Example Family has a human personality?
faq.a: No. Scores measure assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation across repeated API calls, not inner traits.

faq.q: Why are IPIP-HEXACO scores reported on a 1.00-5.00 scale next to 10-50 Big Five sums?
faq.a: IPIP-50 uses 10 items per trait summed to 10-50, while the public-domain 60-item IPIP-HEXACO proxy reports 1.00-5.00 domain means across 24 facets.
